This Crl.M.C. is filed to quash the proceedings in CC No. 839/2019 on the files of Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Alappuzha arising from Crime No.588/2018 of Alappuzha South Police Station.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Alappuzha
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The above case is charge sheeted alleging offences punishable under Sections 406, 409, 420 read with Section 34 of the IPC.

2. After arguing the case for some time, the learned Counsel for the petitioners submitted that the petitioners may be allowed to file a discharge petition and there may be a direction to consider the same within a time frame.
The personal appearance also may be dispensed with during that period.
I think that prayer can be allowed.

Therefore, this Crl.M.C. is disposed of with the following directions:-
i.
The petitioners are free to file a discharge petition before the trial court within three weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

ii. Once such a discharge petition is received, the jurisdictional court will consider the same and pass appropriate orders in it, after giving an opportunity of hearing the petitioners and the prosecutor concerned.

Iii. If the discharge petition is filed as directed above, the personal appearance of the petitioners shall not be insisted by the learned Magistrate, till final orders are passed in the discharge petition.

Sd/-
